model.preset_source: Slide 5 fixes 16 layers / width 256; other settings are official Model constructor defaults: 8 heads, 32 slices, MLP ratio 1, dropout 0, GELU, unified_pos false
reference_gaps: Head count, slice count, MLP ratio and dropout are not present in slide notes; official constructor defaults are used and are not claimed as exact reference settings.
Official Airplane launcher instead uses 4 layers, MLP ratio 2 and dropout 0.1; those task-specific settings are not substituted.
The source-server commit and exact target normalization constants are unavailable.
model.context: every supplied mesh node contributes at every layer; no independent chunk evaluation
model.gumbel_note: Upstream ++ draws Gumbel noise during both train and eval; no guard or replacement added.
model.distributed: world_size=1 process group for unchanged official all_reduce calls

training_protocol: one complete FEM case per update, cycling cases
evaluation: every original node; contextual methods always use complete case context
physical_mse_definition: case-balanced mean of per-case MSE after dividing each physical output channel by its pooled population std; historical case aggregation unavailable
reference_usage: frozen source field is added only at output; NOT a model input
precision: float32 tensors; matmul precision high, TF32 allowed for CUDA matmul/cuDNN
